hints.title: Square Root Bucket Partitioning
hints.text: Partition the n initial numbers into buckets of size B = ceil(sqrt(n)).

hints.title: Locating the K-th Item
hints.text: Iterate across buckets subtracting bucket sizes until finding the bucket containing the target k-th element.

hints.title: Extraction and Tail Relocation
hints.text: Pop the element from its bucket and append it to the last bucket, shifting intermediate bucket boundaries if needed.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Square root decomposition maintains balanced block lengths, bounding each fetch to O(sqrt(N)) operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A standard array shifts up to O(N) items on every fetch, which times out under high query load.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Block subdivision speeds index access and element relocation with minimal pointer overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Square root decomposition or Fenwick indexed tree to execute updates in sublinear time.
